topic: SP-046 follow-ups and the shared /tmp channel
detail: Write sandbox.enabled, allowUnsandboxedCommands=false and the Read(//...) denies together in the root settings.local.json and test that combination from a subfolder, plus Grep, Glob and Edit against the Read deny. SP-046.1 a5 needs a login in a temp profile (user step). Codex has no per-checkout path, so its coverage depends on the launcher. Codex ':workspace' still lets every space write the shared /tmp and $TMPDIR, a cross-space channel read denies don't close.
